rerun_protocol.latent_process: dX_t = -kappa X_t dt + sigma dW_t, with stationary_sd(X)=1 and sigma=sqrt(2*kappa); log V_t=log(xi)+X_t-0.5.
rerun_protocol.discretization: Exact OU transition on n=768 coarse points over T=3, piecewise-constant spot variance within each coarse interval; 64 independent Gaussian fine-return increments per coarse interval.
rerun_protocol.observation_model: Same 64-fine-return BSS-style scaling and additive observation-noise driver/scaling as the frozen checkpoint experiment; four-resolution RV and 27-channel feature code parity-checked.
rerun_protocol.interpretation: The OU controls are out-of-domain semimartingale paths. H=0.5 is a Brownian-regularity boundary reference, not a supervised target observed for these paths. Predictions are diagnostic outputs from frozen rough-trained models, not calibrated estimates of OU roughness.
rerun_protocol.path_seed_rule: For each kappa, the NumPy path seed equals base_seed + round(1000*kappa); the same latent paths are reused across the three observation-noise amplitudes.
